## Why

v1 acceptance requires the spec to document every opcode, modifier and addressing mode, each with tests (C15). The VM and assembler are built and tested against it. ISA balance is a named risk: some designs make one strategy dominant.

## Files

- `docs/spec/isa.md` (new).

## Failing tests

None (document). The spec is the test source for S05, S06 and S17:
- One Markdown table each for opcodes, modifiers and addressing modes, each with a first column `Mnemonic` holding the exact assembler token. S06 parses these tables to check that every entry has a test case, so the table format is fixed by this slice and recorded per C35.
- For each opcode, modifier and addressing mode, at least one worked case (core state before, instruction, core state and process effect after) small enough to transcribe into a Go table-driven test.

## Implement

- Cell: opcode, modifier, operands A and B with addressing modes, plus the last-writer bot id (metadata for the visualizer, not part of the instruction).
- All addresses modulo CORESIZE; define the operand value range and how negative values wrap, in terms that map onto Go integer types without overflow for any allowed CORESIZE.
- Enumerate opcodes, modifiers and addressing modes with semantics, including process effects (spawn, death) and what makes a process die.
- Define the contents of an empty core cell.
- State which Redcode semantics are kept and which differ (C27); Redcode compatibility is a later mode, not v1.
- Keep it to a few pages (PROJECT.md).
- Show the ISA can express the four starter strategies (imp, bomber, replicator, scanner) with a short sketch of each; they are the balance test.
- Detail choices not fixed by PROJECT.md or C27 (mnemonics, operand ranges, table format) are the implementer's, recorded per C35. The ISA as a whole is the game's core design, so the owner reviews the finished spec (see Check).

## Check

- Every opcode, modifier and addressing mode has a table row, a semantics entry and at least one worked case.
- `grep -nE 'TODO|TBD' docs/spec/isa.md` prints nothing.

- Owner input: the owner reviews and approves the spec before S05 starts.
